entries.title: Psalms 68:1
segments: ¶<<To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David. A Song.>> Let God arise, Let His enemies be scattered; Let those also who hate Him flee before Him.

entries.title: Psalms 68:2
segments: As smoke is driven away, So drive [them] away; As wax melts before the fire, [So] let the wicked perish at the presence of God.

entries.title: Psalms 68:3
segments: But let the righteous be glad; Let them rejoice before God; Yes, let them rejoice exceedingly.

entries.title: Psalms 68:4
segments: Sing to God, sing praises to His name; Extol Him who rides on the clouds, By His name YAH, And rejoice before Him.

entries.title: Psalms 68:5
segments: A father of the fatherless, a defender of widows, [Is] God in His holy habitation.

entries.title: Psalms 68:6
segments: God sets the solitary in families; He brings out those who are bound into prosperity; But the rebellious dwell in a dry [land].

entries.title: Psalms 68:7
segments: ¶O God, when You went out before Your people, When You marched through the wilderness, Selah

entries.title: Psalms 68:8
segments: The earth shook; The heavens also dropped [rain] at the presence of God; Sinai itself [was moved] at the presence of God, the God of Israel.

entries.title: Psalms 68:9
segments: You, O God, sent a plentiful rain, Whereby You confirmed Your inheritance, When it was weary.

entries.title: Psalms 68:10
segments: Your congregation dwelt in it; You, O God, provided from Your goodness for the poor.

entries.title: Psalms 68:11
segments: The Lord gave the word; Great [was] the company of those who proclaimed [it]:

entries.title: Psalms 68:12
segments: "Kings of armies flee, they flee, And she who remains at home divides the spoil.

entries.title: Psalms 68:13
segments: Though you lie down among the sheepfolds, [You will be] like the wings of a dove covered with silver, And her feathers with yellow gold."

entries.title: Psalms 68:14
segments: When the Almighty scattered kings in it, It was [white] as snow in Zalmon.

entries.title: Psalms 68:15
segments: ¶A mountain of God [is] the mountain of Bashan; A mountain [of many] peaks [is] the mountain of Bashan.

entries.title: Psalms 68:16
segments: Why do you fume with envy, you mountains of [many] peaks? [This is] the mountain [which] God desires to dwell in; Yes, the LORD will dwell [in it] forever.

entries.title: Psalms 68:17
segments: The chariots of God [are] twenty thousand, [Even] thousands of thousands; The Lord is among them [as in] Sinai, in the Holy [Place].

entries.title: Psalms 68:18
segments: You have ascended on high, You have led captivity captive; You have received gifts among men, Even [from] the rebellious, That the LORD God might dwell [there].

entries.title: Psalms 68:19
segments: Blessed [be] the Lord, [Who] daily loads us [with benefits], The God of our salvation! Selah

entries.title: Psalms 68:20
segments: Our God [is] the God of salvation; And to GOD the Lord [belong] escapes from death.

entries.title: Psalms 68:21
segments: But God will wound the head of His enemies, The hairy scalp of the one who still goes on in His trespasses.

entries.title: Psalms 68:22
segments: ¶The Lord said, "I will bring back from Bashan, I will bring [them] back from the depths of the sea,

entries.title: Psalms 68:23
segments: That your foot may crush [them] in blood, And the tongues of your dogs [may have] their portion from [your] enemies."

entries.title: Psalms 68:24
segments: They have seen Your procession, O God, The procession of my God, my King, into the sanctuary.

entries.title: Psalms 68:25
segments: The singers went before, the players on instruments [followed] after; Among [them were] the maidens playing timbrels.

entries.title: Psalms 68:26
segments: Bless God in the congregations, The Lord, from the fountain of Israel.

entries.title: Psalms 68:27
segments: There [is] little Benjamin, their leader, The princes of Judah [and] their company, The princes of Zebulun [and] the princes of Naphtali.

entries.title: Psalms 68:28
segments: Your God has commanded your strength; Strengthen, O God, what You have done for us.

entries.title: Psalms 68:29
segments: Because of Your temple at Jerusalem, Kings will bring presents to You.

entries.title: Psalms 68:30
segments: Rebuke the beasts of the reeds, The herd of bulls with the calves of the peoples, [Till everyone] submits himself with pieces of silver. Scatter the peoples [who] delight in war.

entries.title: Psalms 68:31
segments: Envoys will come out of Egypt; Ethiopia will quickly stretch out her hands to God.

entries.title: Psalms 68:32
segments: ¶Sing to God, you kingdoms of the earth; Oh, sing praises to the Lord, Selah

entries.title: Psalms 68:33
segments: To Him who rides on the heaven of heavens, [which were] of old! Indeed, He sends out His voice, a mighty voice.

entries.title: Psalms 68:34
segments: Ascribe strength to God; His excellence [is] over Israel, And His strength [is] in the clouds.

entries.title: Psalms 68:35
segments: O God, [You are] more awesome than Your holy places. The God of Israel [is] He who gives strength and power to [His] people. Blessed [be] God!
